sentences.text:
Hence, 
 application be allowed and appellant be released on bail.
Per contra, learned Government Advocate for the respon application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for both the parties and taking note of the fact that appellant has completed 50% of jail incarceration coupled with the fact that final conclusion of this appeal will take considerable time, we deem it appropriate to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant.

Accordingly, I.A.No.2399/2025 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant-R.K. Mahale is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal and it is ordered that the appellant be released on bail on his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and upon furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 05.05.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List this matter for final hearing in due course.
C.C. as per rules.
(VIVEK RUSIA)
